org.bukkit.event.inventory.FurnaceSmeltEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class FurnaceSmeltEvent extends BlockCookEvent
当一个物品烧炼完毕时触发本事件.

原文： Called when an ItemStack is successfully smelted in a furnace-like block such as a Furnace, Smoker, or BlastFurnace.
